quote: Jacobs has seamlessly integrated engineering, construction, and contract operations to deliver several equipment and controls system in a cost-effective manner. For Vancouver’s major control system upgrade, each part of the organization is working hand-in-hand to provide smart state-of-the-art improvements that meet long-term needs for O&M while minimizing impacts to the current operation during construction; maintain treatment plant level-of-service; and maintain or extend service life of assets.
speaker: Frank Dick, PE
title: Sewer and Wastewater Engineering Supervisor
